name: Strike Lab - Combat Training Arena
request: Create a small, playable Strike Lab fighting-game training arena for one player on desktop and touch. Include a humanoid training dummy, a three-hit light-attack combo with visible windup, contact and recovery animations, synchronized hit sound effects, a visible accepted-hit counter and dummy health. The server must validate attack timing and range. Each accepted strike damages and counts once at contact; swinging out of range, holding the button or spamming during recovery must not create extra hits. Show distinct hit and miss feedback. After defeat, reset the dummy and let the player practice again; provide a clear reset control and an uncluttered arena. Search Marketplace first for complete reusable combat/training components, compatible dummy rigs, existing animations and sound rather than rebuilding everything. Inspect compatibility, behavior and included media, preserve useful working pieces and author only missing integration. Source missing audio from Marketplace and verify actual playing animations and audible sounds. Record an importer capability gap honestly rather than treating it as a bad asset. Choose reasonable styling and damage values yourself. No PvP, matchmaking, saving, monetization or large world. Success needs native evidence for the full combo, exact counting, misses, recovery spam, defeat/reset and desktop/touch controls. A damage script with a static dummy does not meet the animation requirement.

assetNeeds.constraints: Short, crisp, punchy melee impact sound effect under 1 second

intent.interaction: Plays precisely when an attack hits the training dummy during the active contact frame.

assetNeeds.role: Swing audio for melee windup and swings
assetNeeds.constraints: Short whoosh / swing sound under 0.6 seconds

intent.interaction: Plays immediately upon initiating each light attack.

spec.assetStrategy: Query Roblox Marketplace for stylized combat training dummy models, hit impact sound effects, and attack woosh audio. For rig animations, use clean procedural joint and Motor6D keyframe/lerp systems layered with humanoid animations to guarantee smooth windup, contact extension, and recovery poses across all client platforms without risking broken external animation asset IDs.
spec.title: Strike Lab - Combat Training Arena
spec.summary: Strike Lab is a focused, responsive fighting-game training arena tailored for desktop and mobile touch devices. The player enters a modern combat dojo equipped with a training dummy, an interactive HUD tracking dummy health and hit count, and intuitive controls (Left-Click/F key on desktop, dedicated on-screen touch buttons on mobile). The combat system features an authored three-hit light-attack combo with distinct windup, contact, and recovery phases. The server strictly validates attack cadence, active contact windows, and player-to-dummy proximity, preventing button-holding exploits and recovery spam. Each valid strike produces synchronized audio, kinetic hit-stop effects, and floating damage numbers, while out-of-range attacks provide immediate miss feedback. Defeating the dummy triggers a knockout sequence and automatic reset, alongside a manual reset control for continuous training.
spec.visualDirection: A clean, modern minimalist combat training dojo ('Strike Lab') featuring a polished dark-slate and neon-accented arena floor, ambient boundary lighting, and focused lighting on the central training ring. The training dummy stands centered on a marked sparring circle with high-contrast health and hit indicators overhead. Attack strikes emit crisp energy arcs and kinetic impact sparks, while floating combat text clearly differentiates 'HIT' (with damage number and combo count) from 'MISS' feedback. The HUD features a sleek, uncluttered fighting-game health bar, dynamic combo counter, and unobtrusive touch controls for mobile players.
